title: Slovakian Falafel Wrap
description: A delicious Slovakian-inspired wrap packed with crispy falafel, crunchy vegetables, and creamy tzatziki sauce.
instructions: Preheat a non-stick pan with a small amount of oil over medium heat.
Cook the falafel according to package instructions, about 5-6 minutes per side.
Meanwhile, slice the lettuce, tomatoes, and red onion.
In a separate pan, heat the tzatziki sauce over low heat.
Assemble the wrap by spreading the tzatziki sauce on the bottom half of the wrap, then adding the cooked falafel, sliced vegetables, and a sprinkle of falafel seasoning.
Top with the remaining wrap half and serve immediately.
